```{r}
library(zellkonverter)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

kidney_non_enrich <- readH5AD("~/Desktop/adata_kidney_non_enrich_qc_r_with_counts.h5ad")
kidney_non_enrich
```

```{r}
# Metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(kidney_non_enrich))

# Raw counts from the "counts" assay
raw_counts <- assay(kidney_non_enrich, "counts")

# Create Seurat object
kidney_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = raw_counts,
  meta.data = meta
)

# Split by sample-level batch
kidney.list <- SplitObject(kidney_seurat, split.by = "sample_id")

# Normalize and find HVGs within each batch
kidney.list <- lapply(kidney.list, function(x) {
  x <- NormalizeData(x, verbose = FALSE)
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(
    x,
    selection.method = "vst",
    nfeatures = 2000,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  x
})

# Select integration features
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = kidney.list)

# Run scaling and PCA for RPCA
kidney.list <- lapply(kidney.list, function(x) {
  x <- ScaleData(x, features = features, verbose = FALSE)
  x <- RunPCA(x, features = features, verbose = FALSE)
  x
})

# Find anchors with RPCA
kidney.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = kidney.list,
  anchor.features = features,
  reduction = "rpca"
)

# Integrate data
kidney.integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = kidney.anchors)

# Downstream analysis on integrated assay
DefaultAssay(kidney.integrated) <- "integrated"

kidney.integrated <- ScaleData(kidney.integrated, verbose = FALSE)
kidney.integrated <- RunPCA(kidney.integrated, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
kidney.integrated <- RunUMAP(kidney.integrated, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
kidney.integrated <- FindNeighbors(kidney.integrated, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
kidney.integrated <- FindClusters(kidney.integrated, resolution = 0.5)
```


```{r}
library(mclust)
library(aricode)

true_labels <- kidney.integrated@meta.data$cell_type
cluster_labels <- kidney.integrated@meta.data$integrated_snn_res.0.5

ari_value <- adjustedRandIndex(true_labels, cluster_labels)
nmi_value <- NMI(true_labels, cluster_labels)

cat("ARI:", ari_value, "\n")
cat("NMI:", nmi_value, "\n")
```


```{r}
library(lisi)

# Use integrated PCA embedding
emb <- Embeddings(kidney.integrated, "pca")[, 1:30]

# Metadata
meta <- kidney.integrated@meta.data

# Compute LISI for both batch and cell type
lisi_res <- compute_lisi(
  X = emb,
  meta_data = meta,
  label_colnames = c("sample_id", "cell_type")
)

# Average scores
ilisi_mean <- mean(lisi_res$sample_id, na.rm = TRUE)
clisi_mean <- mean(lisi_res$cell_type, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Mean iLISI (sample_id):", ilisi_mean, "\n")
cat("Mean cLISI (cell_type):", clisi_mean, "\n")
```


```{r}
kidney_sce <- readH5AD("~/Desktop/adata_kidney_non_enrich_qc_r_with_counts.h5ad")

set.seed(123)

kidney_sce <- logNormCounts(kidney_sce)

dec <- modelGeneVar(kidney_sce)
chosen_hvgs <- getTopHVGs(dec, n = 2000)

kidney_mnn <- fastMNN(
  kidney_sce,
  batch = kidney_sce$sample_id,
  subset.row = chosen_hvgs
)
```


```{r}
colData(kidney_mnn)$cell_type <- colData(kidney_sce)$cell_type
colData(kidney_mnn)$sample_id <- colData(kidney_sce)$sample_id

metadata(kidney_mnn)$merge.info <- NULL

writeH5AD(
  kidney_mnn,
  "~/Desktop/kidney_non_enrich_fastmnn.h5ad"
)
```

```{r}
# Check reduced dimensions

reducedDimNames(kidney_mnn)

corrected <- reducedDim(kidney_mnn, "corrected")

write.csv(
  corrected,
  "~/Desktop/kidney_non_enrich_fastmnn_corrected.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)

meta <- as.data.frame(colData(kidney_mnn))

write.csv(
  meta,
  "~/Desktop/kidney_non_enrich_fastmnn_metadata.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
library(scater)
library(igraph)

set.seed(123)

kidney_mnn <- runUMAP(
  kidney_mnn,
  dimred = "corrected",
  name = "UMAP_corrected"
)

g <- buildSNNGraph(
  kidney_mnn,
  use.dimred = "corrected",
  k = 20
)

cl <- cluster_louvain(g)$membership

meta_out <- as.data.frame(colData(kidney_mnn))
meta_out$cell_id <- rownames(meta_out)
meta_out$cluster <- as.factor(cl)

corrected_out <- as.data.frame(reducedDim(kidney_mnn, "corrected"))
colnames(corrected_out) <- paste0("MNN_", seq_len(ncol(corrected_out)))
corrected_out$cell_id <- rownames(corrected_out)

umap_out <- as.data.frame(reducedDim(kidney_mnn, "UMAP_corrected"))
colnames(umap_out) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
umap_out$cell_id <- rownames(umap_out)

export_out <- merge(meta_out, corrected_out, by = "cell_id")
export_out <- merge(export_out, umap_out, by = "cell_id")

write.csv(
  export_out,
  "~/Desktop/kidney_non_enrich_fastmnn_for_python.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
